messages:
incident-bot: Paging oncall: high error rate and latency for /v1/generate (us-west-2). Hit threshold: 5xx > 2% for 10m. Suspect: KV cache churn + quantized model fallbacks. Pager sent to @Priya R :rotating_light:
Priya R: Acknowledged, I'm on it. Gathering context — who owns runtime changes for hosted pool in us-west-2?
Alex S: runtime + serving. I'm around but heads-down on deploys. tagging @Jamal T for KV/cache/quantization specifics.
Jamal T: looking now. I see anomalous KV eviction spikes starting ~2312343000 and corresponding increase in small-batch low-latency failures. Likely a regression from last night's quant profile roll.
Priya R: Marta, any customer-reported incidents?
Marta L: CS reports a couple customers seeing degraded latencies and truncated responses. Quiet so far on broader support channels but AcmeCorp and NovaPay reported problems to their AEs.
Priya R: Initial impact assessment: ~1.8% of requests hitting > 500ms and ~0.9% 5xx across hosted pool. Affected tenants list from quick query below.
Priya R: (query)
```
# ES: top impacted tenants by 5xx
GET /logs/_search?q=service:inference AND env:prod AND status:5xx&size=10
```
Priya R: Results: AcmeCorp, NovaPay, partner-analytics.
Jamal T: Confirming correlation between KVCACHE_EVICTION_RATE and quant-fallback-rate. Last deploy touched `quant_profile:v2` (rolled Tuesday). Suggest immediate mitigation: revert quant profile for v2 -> `quant_profile:v1`, and temporarily increase KV cache retention / prefix cache TTL to reduce cold-misses.
Alex S: Agreed. Two-step plan: 1) quick revert quant profile on model-v2-hosted, 2) bump kv cache size + TTL on us-west-2 pool. If needed, enable routing to dedicated fallback pool.
Priya R: Who can perform the revert now? I can trigger the config patch and monitor. Jamal, can you do the KV patch?
Jamal T: On it. Patching configmap for hosted-us-west kv: 
```
kubectl -n inference patch configmap kv-cache-config --type merge -p '{"data":{"max_entries":"65536","ttl_seconds":"600"}}'
```
Jamal T: Pushed patch, watching metrics. Eviction rate starting to drop within 30s. :eyes:
Alex S: Revert command for quant profile (console API):
```
curl -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/models/v2/quant/update \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  -d '{"quant_profile":"v1"}'
```
Alex S: I rolled it back to `v1` at 2312345685. Rolling monitors.
incident-bot: Alert suppression: automated fallback enabled for model-v2 -> model-v2-fp16 for 15m by Alex S.
Priya R: Monitoring latency and 5xx now. Early signs look good — 5xx trending down to baseline over last 3 mins.
Marta L: Reached out to AcmeCorp AE, they acknowledged the mitigation and will validate on their end.
Jamal T: KV eviction metric down 78%, quant-fallback metric rolled back to pre-change levels. Posting quick snapshot logs:
```
TIME          kv_evictions  quant_fallbacks  5xx_rate
2312345600    312           48               2.8%
2312345660    45            3                0.6%
```
Jamal T: Looks stable. Rolling back the emergency changes into an RFC for proper change next week.
Priya R: Good. I'm starting the post-incident tracking. We need a postmortem meeting and action items. Proposed time: 2312400000 (tomorrow 09:30 PT).
Alex S: Works for me. I'll present the deploy and quant profile change history.
Marta L: I'll summarize customer contacts and any escalation notes.
Jamal T: I'll own remediation items for KV cache and quantization gating.
Priya R: Action items (initial):
- Priya R: Create postmortem doc and schedule meeting (due: 2312396400).
- Alex S: Add automated canary check for quant_profile changes (add webhook gating) (owner: Alex S, due: 2312970000).
- Jamal T: Add metric + alert for KV cache eviction rate crossing 5% of cache size and implement auto-scale for cache pool (owner: Jamal T, due: 2313056400).
- Engineering: Add rollback/playbook for quant regression (owner: Eng Runtime, due: 2313120000).
- Customer success: Send incident summary to impacted customers and offer remediation notes (owner: Marta L, due: 2312414400).
Priya R: I'm creating the doc now: https://redwood.slackdocs/postmortems/2312345678-kv-cache-incident (placeholder)
Alex S: I'll attach last night's deploy diff to the doc.
Jamal T: I'll link the metrics dashboards and add a small runbook snippet:
```
# quick mitigation steps
1) patch kv-cache-config TTL
2) revert quant_profile via console API
3) enable routing fallback if still degraded
```
SRE Team: :thumbsup: Good coordination. Let's keep this thread updated with postmortem link and owners.
Priya R: Closing pager for now — system metrics stable and customers notified. Will follow up in postmortem. Closing note: please add any additional action items here. :white_check_mark:
